value.title: Jio effect! Reliance beats Tata to become India's most valued conglomerate
value.summary: Jio Platforms’ listing has propelled the Reliance Group to become India’s most valuable conglomerate, with a combined market capitalisation of over Rs 28 lakh crore, surpassing the Tata Group. Jio debuted at Rs 1,358, a 21% premium to its IPO price of Rs 1,119, adding over Rs 12.5 lakh crore to Reliance Group’s market value.

value.title: Infosys, TechM, TCS, other IT stocks plunge up to 5%, extend losses as global AI trade rebounds. What lies ahead?

Strong earnings from SK Hynix and Anthropic’s IPO filing fuelled gains in AI-linked stocks globally. However, concerns over an AI bubble persist, with analysts highlighting a potential advantage for Indian IT services firms.

value.title: TCS, Vedanta among 10 companies offering dividend yield of up to 7%. Do you own any?
value.summary: Currently, numerous companies are enticing income-focused investors with impressive dividend yields. Notably, Vedanta and Coal India shine with a hefty 7% dividend yield. In comparison, Indian Oil Corporation and Bharat Petroleum offer more modest yields at 6%. Conversely, Tata Consultancy Services and HCL Technologies yield at around 4%, targeting distinct investor preferences. These firms highlight the significance of consistent dividend income for shareholders.
